items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: Since we met some time ago in a very pleasant social invitation to your home, I feel that I can call you Helen without insulting your husband Stanley.

ctx.x: Now, this is Sir Charles Thompson. This is Helen Dance interviewing Sir Charles on May 5th, 1975, and Sir Charles, we would like you to start at the very beginning with your birth date and your place of birth, and anything that you would like to tell us about your family, your mother and father. So will you start right in?
Yes. May I call you Helen?
